missionVision.heading: Our mission and vision
missionVision.intro: The beliefs that guide how we walk alongside every adoptive family.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To provide love-based qualified support services for adoptive families in California that encourage a healthy, wholesome and thriving environment for parents and children, guided by education and understanding.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To be an inspiration for adoptive families in a world where everyone has a place for connection, belonging, and an opportunity to learn, develop, and reach their bliss.

founder.lead: An adopted and former foster child, Bryan Post has become one of America's foremost child behavior and adoption experts.
founder.body: A renowned clinician, lecturer, and acclaimed author, Bryan has dedicated his life's work to helping parents and professionals around the world find true peace and healing for challenging children and families through his pioneering application of a love-based, family-centered approach to parenting.

identity.quote: "We believe that every family deserves the chance to thrive, not just survive."

card2.title: Beyond Just Love
card2.body: Love is our foundation, but comprehension is the key. Our staff bring extensive clinical experience to support children and families.

card3.title: 100% Commitment
card3.body: We are fully dedicated to the well-being of adoptive families in California, providing support when it matters most.
